edits.old: The statement that every same-collection update necessarily loops is too broad. MongoDB's engineering example shows that setting already-equal values can leave the document unchanged. Recursion depends on producing another matching change; repeatedly changing timestamps or other fields still needs an explicit guard. (medium confidence)
edits.new: Not every same-collection update necessarily loops: MongoDB skips the update when the two versions of the document are identical, so setting already-equal values leaves the document unmodified. A Trigger that writes a changed value (such as a trigger date) back to its own collection can still fire repeatedly, and MongoDB staff suggest tagging the Trigger's own update and filtering it out in the match expression. Sources: https://dev.to/mongodb/mongodb-optimizes-updates-to-the-same-value-1f2k ; https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/how-to-stop-iteration-of-trigger-when-update-document/184396/1

edits.old: Assuming failed Atlas Functions automatically retry is an anti-pattern. MongoDB explicitly documents no built-in Function retries and describes custom bounded retry mechanisms. This differs from Trigger event redelivery after infrastructure failures; redelivery is not a substitute for application retry design. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
edits.new: Assuming failed Atlas Functions automatically retry is an anti-pattern: Atlas Functions have no built-in retry behavior, and MongoDB documents custom retry strategies (recursive self-call in a catch block with a maximum retry count, or a Database Trigger plus a tracking collection). This is distinct from Trigger event delivery: Atlas guarantees each event is processed at least once, and Triggers may deliver duplicate events when failure or error conditions occur (for example, a server failing before durably recording its progress). Such duplicates are a failure artifact of the delivery guarantee, not a documented Function retry mechanism. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-ui/triggers/functions/handle-errors.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-ui/triggers.md
